review.algorithm_assessment: Order candy types by value per weight using exact cross-products. In an optimum, the worse type count can be below Wr/gcd(Wr,Wb), since exchanging that many for better-type candies preserves weight and does not reduce joy. If Wr is small enumerate this count; if large enumerate affordable better-type count. Both branches O(sqrt C).
